lines.2: My mind snapped awake in an instant.
lines.4: The words slipped from my mouth without thinking.
lines.5: She had taught me 'since long ago' not to lie casually...
lines.6: Long ago... Yes, long, long ago.
lines.7: I knew this person. I remembered this kick.
lines.8: As a kid, I had beaten the neighborhood bully in a fight and grown confident in my strength.
lines.9: This person had shattered that confidence in an instant.
lines.13: 「Even a horse has the right to choose its rider!」
lines.16: 「Father says the strong are allowed to make the weak obey them!」
lines.18: 「Damn it... How are you so strong?!」
lines.19: 「Leo, you are such a wimp that I worry about you.」
lines.22: 「You're the only one I can't beat, Big Sis Otome!」
lines.27: 「Things are gonna be hard for boys when they grow up.」
lines.28: 「So I'll train you so nobody can bully you.」
lines.32: 「Yeah... That kick brought it all back...」
lines.33: 「I would rather not be remembered through a kick.」
lines.34: 「Yeah, it's all coming back. Now that it started, I can't stop it.」
lines.35: 「That is right. I am your older cousin. The Kurogane and Tsushima families are related.」
lines.36: 「We used to play together before you moved here when we were children.」
lines.38: 「That kick rattled my guts. It has to be you, Big Sis Otome.」
lines.39: 「I beat the neighborhood bully and thought I was strong, then you crushed me in an instant!」
lines.41: 「Come on, you used to make me play horse all the time.」
lines.42: 「That was simply the instinct of one born to a warrior family.」
lines.43: 「Actually, now I remember you being the neighborhood bully.」
lines.45: 「I can't believe we went to the same school...」
lines.46: 「Kurogane is an unusual surname. Did you not notice?」
lines.47: 「I always called you Big Sis Otome back then.」
lines.49: 「You were an only child, so I acted as your big sister.」
lines.50: 「You could at least have recognized me when we met.」
lines.52: 「We may be relatives, but we lost touch after you moved. With no funerals or other occasions, we never saw each other. I can understand how you might forget.」
lines.57: 「When I saw how much you had grown, you somehow seemed like a different person.」
lines.60: 「I am honestly disappointed by how undisciplined you are. Inside, you have not changed at all.」
lines.62: 「Were you not going to grow up and become a champion of justice?」
lines.63: 「Wait a second. That was just something a kid says.」
lines.66: 「It truly had fallen entirely out of your memory.」
lines.67: 「You were so attached to me then. How cold you have become.」
lines.68: 「I understand now that being forgotten is surprisingly painful. I understand the meaning of Laurencin's sedative.」
